body.statement:
For every \(P\in\mathcal P_{\beta,d}(L,G,H,\underline f,\overline f)\) and \(\pi\in\Pi_{T,B}\),
\[
\begin{split}
T\,\mathbb E_{P,\xi}\!\Bigg[&\mathbb E_P\!\left[\operatorname{Var}_Z\{\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{IPW}}(M_\pi)\mid (W_i)_{i=1}^T,\xi\}\,\middle|\,(X_i)_{i=1}^T,\xi\right]\\
&-\min_{M\in\mathfrak M_T}\mathbb E_P\!\left[\operatorname{Var}_Z\{\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{IPW}}(M)\mid (W_i)_{i=1}^T\}\,\middle|\,(X_i)_{i=1}^T\right]\Bigg]\\
&=T^{-1}\mathbb E_{P,\xi}[C_g(M_\pi)-O_g(X)].
\end{split}
\]
Consequently, \(R_T(B)\) is exactly \(T\) times the minimax ex ante mean conditional design-variance excess over the prognostic oracle that chooses a matching from the covariates before the latent potential outcomes are revealed.
body.justification: The reduction preserves both the causal estimand and Bai's scalar oracle rather than replacing it by Euclidean matching.
body.gap: Bai's variance criterion is offline and Morrison's reservoir may retain unmatched units; neither yields this forced-empty hard-cap regret identity.
body.consumer: The equality converts every frontier bound into a directly interpretable precision guarantee for the conditional IPW estimator.
body.proof_tex:
For brevity write \(g_i=g(X_i)\) and \(v_i=\operatorname{Var}_P(S_i\mid X_i)\).  The pairwise sign calculation in the proved Lemma \(\mathrm{lem:design\text{-}variance\text{-}identity}\), applied directly to an independently oriented matching \(M\) fixed given the covariates, gives
\[
\mathbb E_P\!\left[\operatorname{Var}_Z\{\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{IPW}}(M)\mid (W_i)_{i=1}^T\}\,\middle|\,(X_i)_{i=1}^T\right]
=T^{-2}\sum_{(i,j)\in M}\mathbb E_P[(S_i-S_j)^2\mid (X_i)_{i=1}^T].
\]
Assumption \(\mathrm{ass:iid\text{-}units}\) gives conditional independence of \(S_i\) and \(S_j\) for \(i\ne j\), while the definition of the prognostic score gives \(\mathbb E_P(S_i\mid X_i)=g_i\).  Hence
\[
\mathbb E_P[(S_i-S_j)^2\mid (X_i)_{i=1}^T]=v_i+v_j+(g_i-g_j)^2.
\]
Every perfect matching uses each index exactly once, so
\[
\mathbb E_P\!\left[\operatorname{Var}_Z\{\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{IPW}}(M)\mid (W_i)_{i=1}^T\}\,\middle|\,(X_i)_{i=1}^T\right]
=T^{-2}\left\{\sum_{i=1}^T v_i+C_g(M)\right\}.
\]
The same calculation conditional also on \(\xi\) applies to \(M_\pi\), because policy nonanticipation makes that matching fixed given \((X_i)_{i=1}^T\) and \(\xi\).  The term \(\sum_i v_i\) is independent of \(M\); Definition \(\mathrm{def:offline\text{-}oracle}\) therefore gives
\[
\min_{M\in\mathfrak M_T}T^{-2}\left\{\sum_i v_i+C_g(M)\right\}
=T^{-2}\left\{\sum_i v_i+O_g(X)\right\}.
\]
Subtracting, taking \(\mathbb E_{P,\xi}\), and multiplying by \(T\) proves the displayed equality.  Taking first the supremum over \(P\) and then the infimum over \(\pi\), exactly as in Definition \(\mathrm{def:minimax\text{-}regret}\), proves the consequence.
